desc: Driver for Liebert UPS, using the ESP-II serial protocol
u: liebert-esp2 - Driver for Liebert UPS, using the ESP-II serial protocol
This man page only documents the hardware-specific features of the liebert-esp2 driver. For information about the core driver, see nutupsdrv(8).
This is an experimental driver. You have been warned.

This driver supports the following optional settings in ups.conf(5):

baudrate=num

Set the speed of the serial connection - 1200, 2400 (default), 4800, 9600 or 19200.
